name: start_research_project
description: Start an R&D research tier. Costs deducted immediately. Completes after sampled duration with sampled quality boost. Tiers are REPEATABLE — same tier can be started again after completion. Only one invocation per tier can be in-progress at a time. Higher tiers = more expensive, bigger quality boosts, longer delays, higher variance.

tier.description: The research tier to start (1-20). Use list_research_projects() to see all tiers and their status.

returns.success: Tier details including cost, sampled duration, sampled quality boost, invocation ID.
returns.error_in_progress: Tier already has an in-progress invocation (wait for completion)

output_schema.name: str — research project name
output_schema.expected_completion_day: int — sim day when project completes

impact: Cash reduced by tier cost. Quality improves permanently when project completes. R&D gives quality jumps that dev spending alone cannot match.

name: list_research_projects
description: List all 20 R&D research tiers with their status. Shows cost, duration distribution, quality distribution, in-progress invocations, and completion history for each tier. Tiers are repeatable.

returns.output: All 20 tiers with: cost, duration mean/std/minimum, quality mean/std/minimum, and current status

output_schema.tiers: List[Dict] — each tier includes configured cost, duration distribution, quality distribution, sampling minimums, and current status
output_schema._access: for t in result['tiers']: print(t['tier'], t['name'], t['cost'])

impact: Read-only. No cost. Use to plan R&D investments.
